The '''1893–94 Scottish Division One''' season was the first season in which the [[Scottish Football League]] had been split between two divisions. The league championship was won by [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]], three points ahead of nearest rival [[Heart of Midlothian F.C.|Heart of Midlothian]].
